name: Midara na Aniyome ni Sasowarete ~Yokkyuu Fuman Jukujo no Tokubetsu Jugyou~
original_name: 淫らな兄嫁に誘われて ～欲求不満熟女の特別授業～
source:
A certain summer.
For Mamoru, a student preparing for college entrance exams, it was an important time.

During this summer, his older brother came home for a visit with his wife, Yumi.

When Mamoru met Yumi for the first time, he was struck by her beauty and thought to himself, 'I didn't know such a beautiful person existed in this world.'

"We'll be staying for three days, so please take care of us!" said Yumi.

And so, Mamoru's summer with his 'ideal woman' began...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1159386]Getcthu[/url]]
